claims.statement: Management states that the e-commerce team has been instructed to grow as much as they can over the next two years.
claims.quote: The e-commerce team in the last two years, have been told very clearly, grow as much as you can, okay? Because we know what the operating model is. It's up to them and their ability about how fast they can grow.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets opening 40 to 45 stores for the year.
claims.quote: what will be the so-called split stores - share of the split stores that had to open because of, say, certain stores getting maxed out, just for reference? Neville Noronha: No, I probably didn't get your question. What did you mean by split stores? Nihal Mahesh Jham: What I meant is you referred that some stores were open because certain existing stores got maxed out. So, when you opened a certain store, they had to ease the capacity from those. So just to understand if those stores will be a larger share of the 40, 45 that you're planning to open.

facts.statement: The pharmacy category is currently available in 7 stores.
facts.quote: Varun Pratap Singh: Okay, so currently, in how many stores we would be having this category available? Neville Noronha: Seven stores.

facts.statement: At the company level, revenue per square foot is at INR32,941.
facts.quote: At a company level, we are at INR32,941 per square feet.
